firstPlayerRule: The tallest person takes the Referee Advisor card and makes the first contract offer or passes.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The rules call the people playing managers, to distinguish them from the basketball player cards.
Taking the Referee during setup also requires returning $2m to the supply.
